Irregularities and extravagances
involving Khadi chief
157. SHRI KARNENDU BHATTA-
CHARJEE: Will the Minister of AGRO
AND RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to the news-item captioned,
"Khadi chief quits posh Niti Bagh house"
which appeared in the Delhi Age dated the
30th May, 2002;
(b) if so, the details thereof and
Government's reaction thereto;
(c) whether it is a fact that the Comptroller
and Auditor General of India pointed out
irregularities and extravagances involved in
the deal; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and the action
taken in regard thereto?
Monitoring of Pradhan Mantri
Rozgar Yojana
158. SHRI SURESH BHARDWAJ:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the nodal authority in respect of
Pradhan Mantri Rozgar Yojana;
(b) the progress achieved in this behalf,
State-wise;
(c) whether it is a fact that Reserve Bank
of India is supposed to monitor the progress;
and
(d) if not, under what circumstances,
CMs of certain States call upon RBI to take
increased interest in PMRY?
KVIC Board
†159. SHRI MUNAVVAR HASAN:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that K.V.I.C. Board
has been constituted;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(d) by when the members of K.V.I.C.
Board would be nominated?

WIN2\SESSION\1940RS 40
PMRY in U.P.
160. PROF. M.M. AGARWAL: Will
the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the amount allocated
and released by Government during the last
three years under the Pradhan Mantri
Rozgar Yojana in Uttar Pradesh;
(b) the details of the amount spent under
the scheme during this period; and
(c) what steps are being taken by
Government to allocate more funds to Uttar
Pradesh during the current financial year?
Sickness in the agro and rural
industries sector
161. MISS MABEL REBELLO: Will
the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the sickness in the agro and rural industries
sector;
(b) the number of small-scale units
closed down in the country during the last
three years, State-wise;
(c) the manner in which Government
Plan to revive these sick units; and
(d) whether there is any financial package
for revival of these units, if so, the amount
allocated for this purpose by Government?
Cyber crimes
162. SHRI ABANI ROY: Will the
Minister of COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have been
actively considering to set up a cell to check
the growing cyber crimes;
(b) if so, whether the online offences
have been increased during the past few
months and the steps taken to check such
crimes have proved ineffective; and
(c) the extent to which the setting up of
cyber crime cell is going to check the
growing online offences in the country?
Guidelines of e-readiness
163. SHRI GHULAM NABI AZAD:
Will the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
constituted a Committee to draft guidelines
for preparing a report on the e-readiness of
all States, Union Territories and Government
Departments;
(b) if so, whether Government would
also initiate to exercise, and facilitate the
smooth development of e-readiness tools in
strategic sectors, departments and regions
across the country;
(c) whether Government have pointed
out that digital language was an important
strategic linkage not only between people
but it was a key catalyst in enhancing
productivity as well as providing
employment opportunities; and
(d) if so, by when this Committee is
likely to submit its report?

provided for the purpose in the form;
